verdict.rationale: Formant documents a public Admin API (bearer-JWT, OpenAPI 3.0.0 definitions embedded per endpoint, live Try It console), plus query and ingestion APIs wrapped by a Python Cloud SDK. Together these let a user drive device configuration, commands, data ingestion and queries programmatically. Missing for 10: a downloadable complete OpenAPI spec (the probe of standard spec paths returned 404 and the full download is admin-gated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
